授業概要
This course provides a comprehensive understanding of nanomaterial synthesis, properties, and their applications.
授業形態
（項目）
Lecture
Assignment

授業形態
（内容）
The content will be introduced during the lectures, and assignments will be given after each lecture. A report on a specific topic will need to be submitted at the end of the semester.
使用する教材等
板書、テキスト（紙媒体）、スライド資料（電子媒体）、映像・音声資料
全体の教育目標
This course aims to equip students with the fundamental knowledge of nanomaterial properties, synthesis, and applications, enabling them to apply this knowledge in their research.
